spec_family.name: Exterior Engineered Wood Siding Prime and Paint
spec_family.description: Combined prime and finish coat painting for engineered wood siding (LP SmartSide lap, panel, T1-11). NOT cementitious — no alkali-resistant primer needed. Covers full prep (low-pressure wash only — NO power washing, scuff sand, end-seal ALL cut edges to prevent irreversible OSB core springback, caulk siding-to-trim joints only — NOT butt joints), field prime, and finish coats. Two substrate-driven primer paths: acrylic (factory-primed/bare wood), bonding (factory-finished ExpertFinish). Three application methods: spray (smooth profiles), spray_backroll (MANDATORY for T1-11, recommended for textured profiles — two-person crew), brush_roll (fallback). Uses SF as primary UOM. Siding profile (lap/panel/t1_11) and surface texture (smooth/cedarmill/roughsawn) drive rate and material modifiers. Access type drives height modifier. Window/door protection is NOT this spec's responsibility — belongs in window/door specs.

includes: Siding field surface preparation (low-pressure wash only — NO power washing, scuff sand per substrate state)
End-sealing ALL field-cut edges (FM-001 prevention — prevents irreversible OSB core springback — non-negotiable)
Caulking siding-to-trim joints (NOT field butt joints — butt joints create moisture trap against OSB core)
Moisture content verification (< 15% MC before any coating — engineered wood is more moisture-sensitive than fiber cement)
Full field prime coat (2 substrate-driven primer paths: acrylic + bonding)
Finish coat application (1-2 coats by quality tier)
Interstage inspection, light sand (QT4), and touch-up
Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based along house perimeter)
Fixture and utility masking (light fixtures, HVAC units)
Spray equipment setup and cleanup (including roller staging for spray_backroll)

excludes.route_to: Window spec (RC-001 from wood siding: window/door protection owned by surface spec)

excludes.route_to: Door spec (RC-001 from wood siding: window/door protection owned by surface spec)

excludes.route_to: PROHIBITED on engineered wood — damages factory primer, forces water into OSB core at joints and cut edges, causes irreversible swelling

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection scrutiny, interstage sanding, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2=economy (single finish coat — LP warranty requires minimum 2 coats but QT2 accepts the trade-off). QT3=standard (2 finish coats per LP SmartSide warranty). QT4=premium (2 finish coats, interstage sand, systematic inspection, premium LP-approved materials). QT5 excluded for siding field per Exterior_Substrates_Doctrine §5.4.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for prime and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray is primary for smooth LP SmartSide. spray_backroll is MANDATORY for T1-11 profile (deep vertical grooves require roller distribution) and recommended for cedarmill/roughsawn textures — requires two-person crew. Brush_roll is fallback for <750 SF, occupied adjacent areas, or high wind. KEY DIFFERENCE from fiber cement: spray_backroll IS valid for engineered wood.

configuration_dimensions.description: Siding profile type. Drives production rate modifier (FAC_ENSD_SIDING_PROFILE).
configuration_dimensions.notes: Lap is baseline (long horizontal runs, fastest production). Panel slightly slower (large flat areas, fewer joints). T1-11 is dramatically slower — deep vertical grooves require mandatory back-rolling and constant repositioning. T1-11 is unique to this spec (fiber cement has shingle instead).

configuration_dimensions.description: Surface texture. Drives production rate AND material quantity modifier (FAC_ENSD_SURFACE_TEXTURE).
configuration_dimensions.notes: Textured profiles trap more paint in valleys, requiring additional spray passes for correct DFT. Affects both production rate and material consumption. Same factors as fiber cement — texture geometry determines consumption, not substrate material.

configuration_dimensions.description: Substrate condition at time of painting. Drives primer selection and prep task activation.
configuration_dimensions.notes: SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY is the dominant NC state. SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD for cut edges/damaged areas/T1-11 without factory prime — standard acrylic primer (NOT alkali-resistant). SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED for ExpertFinish products damaged during construction — requires bonding primer. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD skips prime entirely. NOTE: SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT is NOT valid for this spec — that is fiber cement only.

paintable_items.name: Siding Field
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable siding field area in square feet. Excludes window/door openings, trim boards. Measured per elevation.
paintable_items.notes: Primary and only paintable item. Reused from SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT and SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC — same physical item, different substrate material (engineered wood vs natural wood vs fiber cement). Profile and texture modifiers adjust effective production rates.

variants.notes: Economy spray on lap siding. Single finish coat. Full landscape/hardscape protection for overspray.
Standard spray production on lap siding. Two finish coats per LP SmartSide warranty. Full protection.
Standard spray+backroll on textured lap siding. Two-person crew. Two finish coats.
Standard brush/roll on lap siding. Reduced protection scope — no full landscape or patio cover needed.
Premium spray on lap siding. Interstage sanding. Systematic inspection at 6 ft. Premium LP-approved materials.
Standard spray on panel siding. 1.10x profile modifier on application tasks.
Standard spray+backroll on T1-11 siding. MANDATORY backroll for T1-11 profile. Two-person crew. 1.80x profile modifier. Dramatically slower production.
Economy spray on field-primed surface. Skip prime. Single finish coat. Minimum viable scope.
Standard spray on field-primed surface. Skip prime. Two finish coats.

valid_input_states.notes: Four NC-relevant substrate states. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY is the dominant state (factory-primed engineered wood as delivered). SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD at cut edges and damaged areas — standard acrylic primer (NOT alkali-resistant, engineered wood is neutral pH). SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED for LP SmartSide ExpertFinish products damaged during construction — requires bonding primer. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD for split-mobilization scenarios where prime was applied separately — skips prime module entirely.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen configuration. Satin is the most common exterior siding sheen.

material_systems.name: Standard Acrylic Field Primer for Engineered Wood Siding
material_systems.notes: 100% acrylic exterior primer. NOT alkali-resistant — engineered wood is wood-based (neutral pH), not cementitious. Field prime is MANDATORY per LP SmartSide warranty even over factory primer. Products must be LP SmartSide-approved.

material_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Factory-Finished Engineered Wood (ExpertFinish)
material_systems.notes: Required for LP SmartSide ExpertFinish factory-finished products damaged during construction. Oven-baked factory finish is a non-standard substrate for field paint adhesion — bonding primer provides mechanical grip on the cured factory topcoat.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for Engineered Wood Siding
material_systems.notes: LP SmartSide-approved 100% acrylic exterior latex. Minimum 15-year paint manufacturer warranty. QT2 allows single finish coat. QT3 requires 2 coats standard. Different approved product list than James Hardie.

material_systems.name: Premium Exterior Finish for Engineered Wood Siding
material_systems.notes: Premium LP SmartSide-approved materials with 25+ year warranty. Light sand between coats. Raking light inspection. Semi-gloss available at QT4 for high-visibility accent areas.

production_summary.worst_case_scenario: T1-11, roughsawn, scaffold access (1.80 x 1.30 x 1.60 = 3.744x)

round_configurations.name: Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.description: Standard NC sequence: 1 field prime + 2 finish coats. Required at QT3/QT4.
round_configurations.notes: LP SmartSide warranty requires minimum 2 topcoats. Field prime over factory prime is mandatory per LP warranty.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 1 Finish Coat (Economy)
round_configurations.description: Economy QT2 sequence: 1 field prime + 1 finish coat.
round_configurations.notes: QT2 economy tier. Single finish coat. LP warranty requires minimum 2 coats but QT2 accepts the trade-off.

round_configurations.name: 2 Finish Coats Only (Field-Primed)
round_configurations.description: Skip prime, direct to 2 finish coats. For SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD only.
round_configurations.notes: Field prime already applied in prior mobilization.

round_configurations.name: 1 Finish Coat Only (Economy, Field-Primed)
round_configurations.description: Economy single finish coat on field-primed surface.
round_configurations.notes: QT2 economy on already-primed surface. Minimum viable scope.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: All tasks performed at elevation (see FAC_EXT_ACCESS applies_to list in production.json)
site_condition_rules.effect: ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Access type is a height modifier (like FAC_HEIGHT for interior), NOT a site condition. Applied per elevation. A project may have different access types on different elevations.

site_condition_rules.effect: Spray and spray_backroll tasks excluded when wind is high (>10 mph). SOP reference only — not an estimation modifier per RC-003.
site_condition_rules.notes: Wind monitoring is a scheduling/process constraint, not an estimatable modifier.

site_condition_rules.effect: All coating tasks excluded when dew_point_risk is unsafe. SOP reference only — not an estimation modifier per RC-003.
site_condition_rules.notes: Dew point is a scheduling/process constraint, not an estimatable modifier.

site_condition_rules.effect: Follow shade strategy — work shaded elevations to avoid rapid drying and lap marks. SOP reference only.
site_condition_rules.notes: Sun exposure affects scheduling sequence, not estimation.

site_condition_rules.effect: Surface temperature must be within product TDS range (typically 50-90°F). SOP reference only.
site_condition_rules.notes: Surface temperature is a go/no-go constraint, not an estimation modifier.

site_condition_rules.effect: Engineered wood must be < 15% MC before coating. Moisture check task (TSK_ENSD_MOISTURE_CHECK) catches this. SOP reference only.
site_condition_rules.notes: Engineered wood is more moisture-sensitive than fiber cement. MC check is mandatory at all tiers.

excludes: Window and door protection during siding work — owned by window/door specs (RC-001)
Exterior trim (corner boards, frieze, window/door casing) — separate trim spec
Environmental conditions estimation — excluded from modifiers per RC-003 (SOP reference only)

cross_spec_coordination.notes: No cross-spec flags needed. Window/door protection NOT this spec's responsibility. Trim, soffit, and fascia are separate scopes.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup → Prep → Prime → Finish 1 → Interstage → Finish 2 → Final Inspect → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work in this spec. Siding terminates at trim boards — no cut-in or blending across specs.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Landscape/hardscape protection → Fixture masking → Equipment setup → Coating work → Protection teardown → Equipment cleanup → Site cleanup
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Prep (substrate-state-driven) → Prime (1 coat, skipped for SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD) → Finish coat 1 → Interstage (inspect, sand QT4, touch up) → Finish coat 2 (QT3/QT4) → Final inspect → Touch up
sequencing_notes.elevation_strategy: Work one elevation at a time to minimize protection setup/teardown cycles. Follow shade for optimal conditions.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: spray_backroll is MANDATORY for T1-11 profile. NO high-pressure power washing. NO caulking field butt joints. NO alkali-resistant primer (engineered wood is NOT cementitious).

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Window/door protection during siding work is owned by window/door specs, not this spec. If windows/doors are in scope, their specs handle glass/hardware masking.
relationships.notes: Third exterior siding spec. Shares ITM_SIDING_FIELD and many protection zones with wood siding and fiber cement siblings. Key departures from fiber cement: spray_backroll IS valid (mandatory for T1-11), no alkali-resistant primer (neutral pH substrate), SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD instead of SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT, T1-11 profile instead of shingle, moisture check task added, LP SmartSide product approvals (different from James Hardie). Key departures from wood siding: OSB core (not solid wood), edge seal prevents springback (not just moisture intrusion), factory primer over MDI resin (not raw wood grain).

minor_issue_details.description: Resolution proposed separate COV_ENSD_PRIMER and COV_ENSD_PRIMER_BARE profiles. Materials.json combined them into a single COV_ENSD_PRIMER with per_substrate_state model — superior approach.

Resolution site_condition_rules declares only access_type. Wind/dew_point/temperature referenced in SOP task exclude_when blocks but not enumerated in resolution. Consistent with RC-003 and fiber cement pattern.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior engineered wood siding prime and paint. Third exterior siding spec — follows SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC_v1 pattern with engineered wood-specific departures. Key features: combined prime+paint (single mobilization), 4 NC substrate states (factory-primed, bare wood, factory-finished, field-primed), 3 siding profiles (lap/panel/t1_11), 3 surface textures (smooth/cedarmill/roughsawn), 3 application methods (spray/spray_backroll/brush_roll — spray_backroll mandatory for T1-11), 3 quality tiers (QT2-QT4, QT5 excluded), 29 tasks across 8 modules (23 binary + 4 qt_scaled + 2 qt_conditional), 2 primer systems (acrylic + bonding — NO alkali-resistant), 2 finish systems (standard + premium), 3 factor modifiers (access/profile/texture), max stacking 3.744x under 4.0x cap. QA result: pass (2 minor issues acknowledged, 0 blockers).
